metadata.description: TSVG: Timeseries Scalable Vector Graphics, a vector video format that plays without rendering.

plugins.name: tsvg
plugins.description: Make videos as TSVG documents (XML that plays live, no rendering or encoding): write, check, preview and pack .tsvgz videos with the tsvg CLI; tech-explainer and codebase-explainer styles; the player can voice every line in the browser (Kokoro / sanoTTS). For claude.ai, upload the tsvg-video skill (dist/tsvg-video.zip) and videos play inside artifacts.
